control._why: Duress vs counters/removal, plus threats that stick (hexproof Leatherhead, a planeswalker). Cuts small removal and the slow Saga.

midrange._why: More creature removal (Strategic Betrayal also exiles the graveyard) and a planeswalker; cuts the slow Saga and some Pursuits.

aggro._why: Fire Magic sweeps small creatures; Bitter Triumph kills anything. Cuts slow card-advantage cards. (added 2026-11-23 for the meta round robin)

graveyard._why: Added 2026-11-26: their best against graveyard-based aggro decks (graveyard hate, cards that stop enter triggers, cheap removal, sweepers). Fire Magic sweeps small creatures, Strategic Betrayal exiles the graveyard, more removal and life gain.
